messages.author: 5f533b50135a7f86
messages.subject: Re: [D-RUG]: R/R studio set up on chrome books
parts:
Hey Amanda, 

Chromebooks are designed to have minimal memory and computing power and primarily access cloud services for anything much more demanding than a web browser. If you could get R and RStudio up and running, performance would probably be poor.

These students could access a RStudio Server setup, which basically runs RStudio on a web server. That would require setting up RStudio Server on a server somewhere. 

Dan
